scope: Separate small-scale study. No change to progressive 1000–15000+, its training threshold, or protected benchmark protocols.

arms.baseline: 370 existing reviewed train glyphs, pinned by baseline370.json; verify its provenance against the new benchmark
arms.selection: Nested train-only prefixes by intact verified source groups and unresolved duplicate components; report actual size or skip unreachable level. Do not count augmentations, repeated glyphs or source splits as independent sources. Viet verified is the primary domain; foreign/chart/synthetic require an explicitly separate approved ablation; ambiguous and invalid are excluded.

gates: Accountable approval binding this protocol and frozen manifest by hash before fitting.
Written rights covering exact archive and all contributor sources for intended training; separate evaluation and distribution rights.
Per-glyph confirmed class and usable crop plus source/domain evidence; visual Vietnamese appearance alone is not provenance.

Freeze train/development/test and compare against external, baseline and checkpoint training provenance; no verified group, full SHA256, unresolved pHash or crop-level conflicts; no Pilot/New10/Final Test use for model choice.

Same approved, independently sourced development cohort across sizes, feature choices and fixed detector boxes. Keep final test sealed. If vehicle-level independence is unknown, disclose it and do not waive existing eligibility gates.
Only run a level when sufficient eligible new train glyphs remain after group/leakage checks; zero currently eligible.

experiments.cnn: Use a copy of a provenance-verified V1 extractor, with a frozen backbone and trainable character head first. Compare matched baseline and augmented arms at the same recipe; fine-tune late layers at lower LR as a separate matched ablation after protocol approval. Keep 32x32 preprocessing identical to checkpoint contract; log optimizer, LR, checkpoint origin, epochs, early stopping and seed 42. No changes to V1 weights.
experiments.svm_rf: Use HOG 324 + frozen CNN V1 embedding 256 (fusion 580). Fit scaler only on training fold; group-aware folds; keep mean sample weight 1 and fixed hyperparameters per matched size arm. Report shared-extractor provenance, not independent CV when groups overlap its training.

metrics: Glyph accuracy, macro F1, class support/recall, confusion matrix and runtime with group-level uncertainty. Exact plate match and CER only with independently verified full text on the same fixed end-to-end cohort and unchanged detector; missing detections count as empty predictions. Do not pick on final test.
implementation: Protocol only. No pilot fitting CLI or output manifest approved. Do not invoke the progressive runner using sub-minimum levels.
